about_the_game:
My Paradise Lagoon is a first-person tropical fishing simulator built in Unreal Engine 5, where your lighthouse island becomes a home base for mastering rods, reels, lures, and advanced fishing techniques across a vibrant ocean ecosystem.

Here, the joy comes from realism, variety, and the feel of every cast.

🎣 Master Real Fishing Techniques
Cast from sandy shallows, reef edges, cliff drops, or your boat as exotic species glide under turquoise waves.
Each fish reacts with lifelike intelligence—darting, circling, diving, or making sudden runs based on species, weight, and temperament.

Use real angling techniques:

  • Rod angle management

  • Line tension control

  • Drag tuning

  • Hook sets and reel pumping

  • Landing and lifting larger fish by hand

Every fight feels physical, cinematic, and earned.

🎣 Gear Matters: Rods, Reels, Lures & Tools
Build your perfect loadout with a full suite of fishing gear:

  • Light, medium, and heavy rods

  • Spinning, baitcasting, and trolling reels

  • Line types with real stretch and strength differences

  • Species-specific lures, baits, and rigs

  • Utility tools like landing nets, gaffs, fish bags, and gloves

Upgrade each piece to unlock new casting distances, drag stability, and specialized techniques for deep sea, reef, or shallow fishing.

🏝️ Your Lighthouse, Your Angler’s Workshop
Your lighthouse becomes a functional fishing hub:
organize your rods, store trophies, repair gear, and craft new lures.
Explore deeper into the island to find hidden coves, coral lagoons, stormy cliffs, and offshore hotspots where rare species challenge your skills.

🌤️ Powered by Unreal Engine 5
The lagoon shines with tropical color and realism:
dynamic waves, volumetric clouds, shimmering water, and fish animations designed for smooth, lifelike motion.
Every cast and reeling sequence feels natural and immersive.

🎥 Designed for Pure Fishing Satisfaction
Physics-based fights, rod bends, tight lines, splashing surfaces, and wriggling catches make every moment highlight-worthy.
Perfect for relaxed sessions, ASMR reels, or showcasing rare catches.

🧺 Features

Advanced First-Person Angling: Rod angle, drag control, tension management.
Gear Depth: Multiple rods, reels, lures, lines, and angling tools.
Fish Behavior Simulation: Species-specific reactions and fight patterns.
Functional Lighthouse Home: Workshop, storage, upgrades, and gear crafting.
Multiple Biomes: Shallows, reefs, cliffs, coves, and offshore waters.
Relaxing Loop: No pressure, just skillful fishing at your own pace.

Cast deeper. Fight smarter. Build the perfect angler’s loadout.
Welcome home to My Paradise Lagoon, the ultimate tropical fishing simulator.
